title: Work Done Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The calculation of work done must correctly apply the formula W = p(V2 - V1) with appropriate values.

title: Internal Energy Change
description: Essential Criteria: The change in internal energy must be calculated using the correct relation ΔU = Q - W.

title: Entropy Change Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The change in entropy must be determined using the formula ΔS = Q/T with correct values.

title: Correct Units
description: Important Criteria: All final answers must include correct units for work, internal energy, and entropy.

title: Sign Convention
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs for work done and internal energy change.

title: Density Values
description: Important Criteria: The densities of ice and water must be correctly applied in the volume calculations.

title: Heat of Fusion
description: Important Criteria: The heat absorbed must correctly reflect the heat of fusion value given in the problem.

title: Temperature Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The temperature used in the entropy calculation should be consistently stated in Kelvin.
